checkpoint.title: Down the Cycling Road (Route 17) with its RARE CANDY and MAX ELIXIR, to the Safari Zone's door in Fuchsia City

events.why: the Items pocket's counts before the slope, on flat ground: the items found on it are confirmed against them on Route 18
west through the Cycling Road gate (27, 13) to (20, 13), on the Bicycle (both gates keep a rider on it), and on to (17, 13), east of the six Bikers' sight

the six Bikers (LOOK_AROUND, sight 1) leave no way past out of every one's sight, so each leg that may be seen is one tile, the trainer seeing the player on its end, where the walk goes on from after the battle: along row 13 through Lao's (16, 13) and Hideki's (14, 13) to (13, 13), down column 13 through Hideki's (13, 14) to (13, 15), down to (13, 19) and east to the wall (14, 19), above Route 17's column 14 (pokeguy's way down: no Biker fought by choice)

Route 17 has no map (mapless): onto the slope at (14, 0), rolled to the water (14, 29); 3 east to (17, 29), rolled and braked in rows 62..81 (past Zeek's row 61, above Corey), 1 east to column 18, south a tap and an A at a time until the hidden RARE CANDY (18, 83) answers at (18, 82); 1 east, rolled to the wall (19, 136); 3 west to (16, 136), 2 south through the gap (14..16, 137), 2 west to (14, 138), south a tap and an A at a time until the hidden MAX ELIXIR (14, 157) answers at (14, 156); 2 west to (12, 156), rolled through the ledges' gap (12, 158) to the slope's foot (12, 159), and south onto Route 18 to the water (12, 10)
each one more than before the slope: both items were found

the slope's count of taps leaves the player on (12, 10) only if every tap moved a tile: up a tile, west to the wall (8, 9) and down to the water (8, 10) find them from a tile either way, before the gate's door (41, 9) needs the row

east along Route 18 through its gate (Route18_EastEntrance_1F) into Fuchsia City and up to below the Safari Zone's door (24, 5); pokeguy goes straight there, no Center. Without Cut, Fuchsia's east side is the only way from Route 18 to the door: the Cut trees (24, 22) and (21, 13) close the middle (pokefirered FuchsiaCity map.json), and pokeguy's 31 s from the MAX ELIXIR to the Safari Zone's menu (1:12:53 to 1:13:24) fit a ride round the east side better than two Cuts

checkpoint: From east of the Cycling Road gate (11.01), pokeguy's way down Route 17: the hidden RARE CANDY (18, 83) and MAX ELIXIR (14, 157) only; the FULL RESTORE, PP UP and MAX REVIVE are left, and no Biker is fought by choice (pokefirered Route17 map.json). His brief START menu near the Bikers is left out: it changes nothing.
The slope's speeds and B's brake are not measured on the console yet (SlopeMechanics in PokemonFRLG_AutoStorySlope.h): measure them on Route 17 before a counted run.
The save is in front of the Safari Zone's door, FUCHSIA CITY on the save card.
